experiments.question: Where does the champion's residual live?
experiments.hypothesis: H021: champion residual has structure conditional on scheduled/observable events (halving distance), interval dispersion, prior-adjustment sign, price volatility, fleet-fingerprint change, timestamp-error level, season, or template-build gap
experiments.why_now: mandatory residual-first search; the residual (sd 3.7pp at k=500) is the only unexplained variance left in the difficulty track
experiments.method: 12 pre-registered residual covariates under P1 at k=0 and k=500; Spearman + block-bootstrap; Bonferroni 24 tests; any survivor -> EXP23 residual model under P1
experiments.success: any covariate with |rho|>0.25 surviving Bonferroni and consistent sign across 2021-23 vs 2024-25
experiments.failure: none survive -> residual declared unstructured w.r.t. available observables

experiments.question: ADAPTIVE: if EXP22 finds structure, does BASE+RESIDUAL beat BASE under P1? If not, cancel and preserve budget
experiments.success: paired MAE reduction >5% with CI excluding 0, no regime failure

experiments.question: Does the stratum job-issuance stream provide a propagation measurement that is independent of the observer panel (finder head-start), and does that disjoint-source feature replicate the orphan-risk signal killed in EXP21?
experiments.hypothesis: H022: first mining.notify time approximates block creation time (finder pool reacts at t~0); delay_net = first observer arrival - first job = network propagation lag; H018e: delay_net(h-1) predicts competing block at h with label from dbg nodes (disjoint from stratum source)
experiments.why_now: new information source not yet modeled; only clean way to resurrect or bury the orphan question; 2024-06..2025-12 coverage
experiments.method: bimodality test of (first job - first arrival); construct delay_net; leakage-safe (job of h-1 before arrival of h); Fisher + AUC vs 29 competing events; null = permutation; also delay_net vs template-build gap (H020)
experiments.success: AUC CI excludes 0.5 on disjoint-source feature
experiments.failure: AUC ~0.5 -> orphan-risk branch closed at L0
